protocols: Rotated repetitions per configuration; same requests and mapped provider. Batch horizon=16 already pending requests, no artificial queue-fill wait. Modes off/batch/existing Session prefetch after 3 sequential reads/guarded threshold 8. Split reads off. One background worker. Caller work 0 or synthetic busy-wait 50 us per logical request, paid after each common 16-request window. Every mode uses the same 16-request timing windows and output buffers. Generated traces, not recorded gameplay. Read service includes batch planning and merge/scatter. Session/worker shutdown is measured separately; total including shutdown is also reported. Original-order output staging copies are timed, common full-output storage is included in process RAM. Output file is written only after workers stop and measurements finish, then checked via SHA-256. OS cache uncontrolled. CPU and memory are entire-process peaks/costs; speculative payload stats sampled before worker drain. Decoder count after drain. No production changes.
